first.rationale: Current situation shows dual pressure: QoQ activation down 6%, onboarding down 4%, plus competitive pricing threat to SMB segment. Memory_73 directly supports promotional_pricing as effective for price-sensitive SMBs with acquisition lift. Memory_86 suggests onboarding simplification works, but activation decline is the more acute signal requiring immediate response to competitive threat. Verifying memory_86 to confirm onboarding gains were durable and memory_73 to validate pricing efficacy under current market conditions before committing. Promotional_pricing targets the immediate competitive threat while preserving qualified revenue focus (memory_73 showed no measurable retention harm). Standard_experiment scale appropriate—broad rollout risks brand/margin if competitive response intensifies; small test may miss revenue opportunity. Risk flagged: aggressive pricing can commoditize positioning and may attract less-qualified cohorts requiring scrutiny in post-test analysis. Activation messaging (memory_91) is secondary option if verification reveals pricing strategy risks downstream LTV.

final.rationale: Archive verification reveals critical flaw in initial intent: memory_73 shows promotional_pricing drives qualified-revenue lift short-term but retention collapses 12% by first renewal—directly contradicting primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. This disqualifies promotional_pricing despite competitive pressure. Memory_86 verification confirms onboarding simplification is durable: +13% completion, -2.1 days time-to-value, +3% retention. This addresses both active problems (activation -6%, onboarding -4% QoQ) while maintaining retention discipline. Memory_31 corroborates: signup simplification lifted SMB first-week activation durably. Activation decline likely downstream of onboarding friction compounding drop-off. Simplify_onboarding targets root cause without renewing customer cohort quality risk. Standard_experiment scale: sufficient to detect the +13% completion lift observed in memory_86, with week-one learnings informable for rapid expansion if confirmed. Preserves uncertainty is false because verification has eliminated the high-risk option and surfaced the aligned choice; no material uncertainty remains about qualified-revenue sustainability.
